settings.subtitle: City Hall is at 300 W Main St and is open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. For police, fire or medical emergencies, always call 911.

settings.headline: Visit City Hall
settings.body:
City Hall is at 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX 78600, on the corner of Main and 3rd Street. Free parking is behind the building, with accessible spaces by the north entrance.

Utility billing and the City Secretary are on the first floor. Development Services is in the annex next door, at 310 W Main St.

Write to us

Email cityhall@juniperfalls.example and we will route your question to the right department, usually within one working day.
settings.side: Reporters can reach the Communications Office at news@juniperfalls.example or (555) 010-4020.
